profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Sony Interactive Entertainment
profile.summary:
Staff Java/Software Engineer with more than 10 years of experience at industry leaders such as Sony Playstation, Intuit, AOL, Netscape, and Oracle.  Proven track record in object-oriented design and development of highly scalable, durable, and secure cloud services leveraging Amazon Web Services in an Agile environment.  Strengths and career highlights include the following:

•	Production lifecycle management: Led full life-cycle development including requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance of a web service that grew from zero to tens of millions of users and millions of notifications sent a day. 

•	Distinguished problem solver:  Awarded US Patent 7496631 as co-inventor of “Delivery of an electronic communication using a lifespan.” Earned company-wide recognition for Excellence in Problem Solving for my work with customer satisfaction, performance tuning, and deployment issues. 


Specialties: Languages: Java, SQL, JSON, Javascript, Ruby, XSD/XML/XSLT
Technologies: Amazon Web Services, Kubernetes, Splunk, Datadog, Guice, JUnit
Methodologies: Design Patterns, MVC, OOA/D, UML, TDD, SCRUM, Agile
Operating Systems:	Mac OS X, Linux, Windows
Database: DynamoDB, Apache Cassandra, MongoDB, NoSQL, Big Data, Oracle, Sybase, MySQL, Sharding, Tuning
Software:	IntelliJ, Eclipse, Maven, Jenkins,

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description: Developed, managed, and deployed Neustar's Web Performance Management Agent Network.  This system remotely controls thousands of browsers located in all 8 Amazon EC2 regions and in over 100 other data centers all over the world using technologies such as Java, Selenium/Webdriver,  Javascript, BrowserMob Proxy, and Rhino.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and implemented Consumer Financial Data Platform allowing customers to effectively manage their data on any device. This highly available, active/active platform utilizes Cassandra, Gluster FS, and Mule ESB to distribute the data across multiple racks and data centers and provides a multi-protocol, multi-format interface to the data. 

•	Spearheaded new use of existing Authentication/Authorization subsystem for Consumer Financial platform application later released across business units as a cost and development best practice. 

•	Reduced integration time with internal teams from weeks to days through a self-service website, rich out of the box examples, and flexible application level authentication.

positions.title: Senior Software Lead Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Led development of hardware and software solutions to decrease hemodialysis treatment time and reduce hypotensive symptoms by patients. Managed team of external developers based in Taiwan, monitoring work performance and overseeing project progress through Scrum. 

•	Designed and implemented Spring MVC based web application in Java using Hibernate and MySQL that provided easy, fast access for patient current and historical diagnostic data through a web interface and RESTful APIs

•	Automated manual process, decreasing administrative time and replacing error-prone legacy process.

positions.title: Technical Lead / Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Managed the full development of AOL Alerts, leading construction of underlying architecture and database design, serving as mentor for team of engineers, and monitored progression of project over time. Developed processes and procedures to realize cost and time savings, increasing corporate efficiency while maintaining the integrity of the product.

•	Eliminated 10% of all notification failures in Twitter-like application by quantifying the top issues impacting the user.  Reduced the cycle-time for identifying user issues from days to hours by creating a website that measured customer satisfaction hourly.

•	Awarded US Patent 7496631 as co-inventor of “Delivery of an electronic communication using a lifespan.” Earned recognition for Excellence in Problem Solving for my work with customer satisfaction, performance tuning, and deployment issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Established integration with SAP R/3 and Oracle Applications with Netscape ECXpert Platform which managed business to business EDI based trading relationships over the web.

* 	Enhanced product differentiation and positioning by developing an adapter to SAP that was certified by SAP Labs for ALE (Application Link Enabled) for R/3 3.1H and an adapter to Oracle Applications that was certified by Oracle Applications R10.7 and R11.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Authored and directed magnetic tape reporting module for Oracle Payroll Application.

patents.title: Delivery of an electronic communication using a lifespan
patents.description: Providing an electronic notification to an intended recipient includes communicating an electronic notification directed to an intended recipient, determining a lifespan related to a duration of relevance of the electronic notification, and providing the electronic notification to the intended recipient when the lifespan has not expired. The duration of relevance describes a time period during which information of the electronic notification reasonably may be expected usefully to inform an action or interest of the intended recipient. After the lifespan expires, provision of the electronic notification to the intended recipient may be prevented.
